title: I redid my games art based on feedback
author: TheGrowthYardGaming
selftext:
I had a pixel resort that was using hi-res images for the actual games you play and it just felt out of touch. Some of them did look good but I think this was an overall positive change.

  
I am still updating them and going through each machine to work on polishing it but if you would like to try yourself here is a link. Let me know what you think and if this was a step in the right direction. 

  
[https://play.sunspireresort.com/](https://play.sunspireresort.com/)

comments.author: WWEtrump
comments.body: good call listening to feedback and actually redoing it, most people just defend the first version. matching art style makes the whole thing feel more like one place

replies.author: TheGrowthYardGaming
replies.body:
Yea I was gatekeeping sharing my game in the early stages but getting advice from real people has only made things 10 times better. I know my game needs a lot of work. I have a vision and an entire notebook with the scope and plans for the full game.

  
But you learn so much as you build and things change when you get real people playing it. So all constructive criticism is welcome.
